Subject: [UAI] CP-AI-OR 2005: Call for Participation

===================================================================
                Call for Participation / Registration

                          CP-AI-OR 2005
2nd International Conference on Integration of AI and OR Techniques
 in Constraint Programming for Combinatorial Optimisation Problems

                       Prague, Czech Republic
                        May 30-June 1, 2005

          Early registration deadline is March 28, 2005

     MASTER CLASS ON METAHEURISTICS AND CONSTRAINT PROGRAMMING
                       Prague, Czech Republic
                            May 29, 2005

                   http://cpaior05.mff.cuni.cz/
===================================================================


CONFERENCE PROGRAMME:
=====================

The aim of the conference is to bring together interested researchers from
AI and OR, and to give them the opportunity to show how the integration of
techniques from AI and OR can lead to interesting results on large scale and
complex problems. A secondary aim of CP-AI-OR is to provide an opportunity
for researchers in one area to learn about techniques in others.

>>From almost 100 submitted papers, 26 papers have been selected to be
presented in the main program.

For details, please see http://cpaior05.mff.cuni.cz/program.html


MASTER CLASS:
=============

As in previous years CPAIOR'05, a major forum on the Integration of OR
and AI techniques in CP, will be preceded by a one-day Master Class
where leading researchers give introductory and overview talks in a
given area. This year, the topic of the Master Class is
Metaheuristics and Constraint Programming. The Master Class is
intended for PhD students, researchers, and practitioners. A basic
knowledge of Constraint Programming will be expected of participants.

For details, please see http://cpaior05.mff.cuni.cz/master_class.html


CONFERENCE VENUE:
=================

The conference and the Master Class will take place in a newly refurbished
building of Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, Charles University, Prague.
This building has a convenient location in the historical city center, in
the area called Lesser Town (Mala Strana) close to local attractions like
Charles Bridge (Karluv most) and Prague Castle (Prazsky hrad).


REGISTRATION:
=============

To participate at Master Class and/or CP-AI-OR 2005 conference you must
register and pay the registration fee. Please use the registration form
available at http://cpaior05.mff.cuni.cz/registration.html

A limited number of student grants is available.


IMPORTANT DATES:
================

Student grants:     March 21, 2005
Early registration: March 28, 2005
Late registration:  May 20, 2005

Master Class:       May 29, 2005
CP-AI-OR'05:        May 30-June 1, 2005
